subject: Request: hosted I/O economics, model roster, and volume tiers
messages:
From: Amy Li <amy@heliohealth.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 18:12:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted I/O pricing and model roster

Hi Grace,

I lead platform at HelioHealth — we’re evaluating hosted inference vendors for patient-facing summarization and triage flows. Could you send your standard per-1M token IO pricing (clearly called out input vs output), and a current list of hosted models (and which are recommended for chat vs high-throughput embeddings)?

We expect to ramp from ~3M tokens/month up to 12M tokens/month over the next 6 months if things look good. A couple clarifying points:
- Does your pricing change for streaming responses?
- Any public rate card or a PDF you can share?
- Do you offer volume discounts or committed tiers?

I attached our signed NDA so we can exchange rate details if needed. Looking to move quickly — appreciate anything you can share today or tomorrow.

Thanks,
Amy Li
Platform Lead, HelioHealth
amy@heliohealth.com
Attachment: HelioHealth_NDA_signed.pdf
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Amy Li <amy@heliohealth.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted I/O pricing and model roster

Hi Amy — thanks for the NDA and context. Quick overview below (I’m sending our public baseline ratecard as well):

Short answers up front:
- Baseline (hosted API, no commitment) is charged per 1M tokens with input/output split. See attached rate card (redwood-hosted-ratecard-v1.pdf).
- Streaming responses are billed the same per-token; no separate streaming surcharge.
- We do volume-based discounts for committed monthly minimums — see tiers below.

Baseline per-1M (USD, hosted API, std models):
- General chat model (rwd-chat-1): $1,200 per 1M tokens (input/output combined, typically we show as $400 input / $800 output for typical chat splits)
- Lighter chat (rwd-chat-lite): $700 per 1M tokens (good for short-turn assistants)
- Embeddings (rwd-embed-1): $350 per 1M tokens (embedding units)
- Large-context / long-form (rwd-long-1): $1,600 per 1M tokens

Example IO split notes (we publish both ways):
- For a chat with average 80 tokens in / 300 tokens out we’d show input = 80/380 of the per-1M and output = 300/380 — our ratecard presents input/output so you can estimate.

Volume discount guidance (hosted API):
- 5M+ committed / month: ~15% off baseline
- 15M+ committed / month: ~25% off baseline + 1-month free onboarding credits
- Enterprise (>50M): custom pricing and SLA

Attached: redwood-hosted-ratecard-v1.pdf (public baseline + examples).

A couple quick requests so we can firm up a tailored quote:
1) Can you share an expected token mix by model (chat vs embeddings) and average input/output lengths?
2) Any compliance/SLA expectations beyond our standard hosted terms?

If you’re available I can put Jonas (solutions/sales engineering) on a 30-min call today to go through a worked example.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-hosted-ratecard-v1.pdf
From: Amy Li <amy@heliohealth.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, procurement@heliohealth.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted I/O pricing and model roster

Thanks Grace — that helps a lot. A few specifics to help you tailor the quote:
- Expected monthly mix (months 1-3): 80% chat (rwd-chat-1 preferred), 20% embeddings. We plan to use chat for patient summarization and triage (avg input ~80 tokens, avg output ~350 tokens).
- Region: US-only initially (data residency in us-west).
- Streaming: yes for triage flows — good to know streaming doesn't change the unit rate.

Procurement asked if we could get a short SOW + indicative committed tier pricing for 6 months — I attached a draft SOW with expected usage patterns. Can you confirm whether the rate card you sent includes both input and output line items or a combined per-1M? Our CFO likes the separate IO breakdown for forecasting.

Also — do you provide any introductory trial credits or pilot packages for prospects still in evaluation?

Appreciate quick turnaround, we’re trying to get indicative numbers for procurement by end of week.

—Amy
Attachment: HelioHealth_SOW_draft.docx
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Amy Li <amy@heliohealth.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted I/O pricing and model roster

Hi Amy — copying a concise set of next-step numbers so procurement has something to work with. We’ll follow with a formal SOW and a worked example table once you confirm the month-1 expected split.

Indicative (US-hosted API, per-1M tokens, separate input/output):
- rwd-chat-1: $1,200 per 1M total (input $380 / output $820)
- rwd-chat-lite: $700 per 1M (input $220 / output $480)
- rwd-embed-1: $350 per 1M (embeddings counted as one-side units)

Pilot / credits: we typically offer $15k of pilot credits for trials that convert within 90 days (applied to hosted usage).

Volume quick offers (indicative, requires MSA + commitment):
- 5M/mo commit: 15% off baseline + 1 week of free onboarding support
- 15M/mo commit: 25% off baseline + dedicated onboarding and a single technical workshop

Notes:
- Pricing above is quoted for US regions; EU has modest region uplift.
- Streaming is billed token-for-token (no surcharge).
- We’ll include IO line items in the SOW for your CFO — easy to export as a monthly forecast table.

Grace — if you can confirm month-1 split (chat vs embeddings) and expected average IO lengths I’ll produce a simple 6-month pricing table (monthly tokens, gross cost, discounts, credits).

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
